Elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on wins/losses. Opening this thread to collect concrete asks.
Marco: Recap: wins = Dedicated SLA clarity, faster inference perf; losses = Private onboarding friction and cost unpredictability.
Priya: Customers repeatedly mention KMS/network validation taking too long for Private. They want a checklist and a fast validation path.
Jun: I'll prepare a minimal Nginx+VPC example and a KMS quickstart snippet for docs.
Sam: Do we have data on loss reasons by segment? Cost vs quality?
Priya: Mid-market: cost. Enterprise: security and SLA. We lost 3 mid-market deals last Q over unit cost.
Ava: Request: a one-page "ask -> owner -> ETA" CS can hand prospects. Short, with perf expectations.
Marco: I'll own that. ETA two weeks. Contents: Dedicated SLA, Private quickstart links, cost knobs (batching, quant), perf p50/p95 ranges, and rebuttals.
Jun: I'll find a redacted case example of hosted->Dedicated cost drop.
Sam: Roadmap prioritization? Scripts vs console-guided deploy?
Marco: Short-term: scripts/templates (2w). Medium-term: console guided flow (Q2).
Ava: Can we auto-trigger a 1-pager postmortem on lost-deal CRM tag and route to Product? Rev Ops volunteered to wire it.
Priya: Confirmed. Sarah (Rev Ops) will own automation.
Elena: Action list: Marco = one-pager (2w), Jun = case study (1w), Docs = Private quickstart (2w), Rev Ops/Sarah = CRM->postmortem.
Sam: Add a tiny decision checklist for model variant tradeoffs (latency vs quality vs cost).
Jun: Will add a 3-item checklist.
Ava: GTM can review drafts in 24-48h if tagged.
ops-bot: Created task #4620 "All-hands customer one-pager" assigned to Marco. Due 2026-04-10.
Elena: Thanks all, will include updates in next all-hands.
